product_overview: JobPilot helps international students find verified, open job listings that match their region, field, degree and visa needs, and it generates tailored cover letters from a parsed resume. The public site includes a demo verifier and pricing page; authenticated users can onboard, upload a resume, search verified jobs, and generate cover letters.
core_goals: Quickly verify whether a job posting is currently accepting applications (demo and live checks).
Parse an uploaded resume to extract degree, direction, skills and visa needs so users do not have to enter details manually.
Present only jobs that satisfy the Core Promise (open + location match + direction match + identity/degree/visa match).
Enable one-click generation of a tailored cover letter for a selected verified job using the user's parsed resume.
Expose pricing and an upgrade path (Stripe checkout) while keeping core search and resume workflows available to free users.

features.name: Landing Page & Demo Verification
features.description: Public marketing homepage with value proposition and a demo widget that verifies a job URL live to show whether a posting is still open and meets basic match criteria.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Read hero value proposition and CTAs -> Enter a job URL into the demo verify widget -> Submit the demo URL -> See a verification result that indicates whether the job is currently open and meets basic matching criteria
Navigate to / -> Enter an invalid or malformed URL into the demo verify widget -> Submit the demo URL -> See a validation message explaining the URL format requirement

features.name: Onboarding & Resume Upload
features.description: Collect first-time user profile (region, direction, degree, visa needs) and upload a resume (PDF or DOCX) to extract a structured profile used for search and cover letter generation.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> See onboarding prompt for region, direction, degree, and visa needs -> Select region -> Select direction -> Select degree -> Indicate visa needs -> Upload resume PDF or DOCX -> Submit onboarding -> See parsed profile summary and initial job search results
Navigate to /dashboard -> See onboarding prompt -> Attempt to upload a file that is not PDF or DOCX -> See a validation error indicating supported resume formats

features.name: Dashboard — Job Search & Core Promise Results
features.description: Authenticated dashboard that runs search using the user's profile and displays only jobs that pass the Core Promise gate (open, location match, direction match, identity/degree/visa match). Provides region and degree filters to refine results.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> See job results that reflect your selected region, direction, degree, and visa needs -> Apply a region filter -> Apply a degree filter -> See filtered results where each listed job indicates it passed the Core Promise
Navigate to /dashboard -> See job results -> Update direction or degree in the UI -> Submit updated criteria -> See updated job list that respects the new criteria

features.name: Cover Letter Generation
features.description: Generate a tailored cover letter for a selected verified job using the user's parsed resume; the letter streams progressively and the final text can be copied for use in applications.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Select a job from the results -> Request cover letter generation for that job -> See the generated cover letter stream progressively as it is created -> Wait for generation to finish -> Copy the final cover letter to clipboard

Navigate to /dashboard -> Select a job -> Request cover letter generation without having uploaded a resume -> See a validation prompt instructing you to upload or parse a resume before generating a cover letter

features.name: Pricing & Stripe Checkout
features.description: Public pricing page that compares free and paid tiers and initiates a Stripe Checkout session when a user chooses to upgrade.
user_flows: Navigate to /pricing -> Review plan comparison and feature differences -> Choose the Upgrade action for the paid tier -> Start the checkout flow -> Be redirected to the Stripe checkout page
Navigate to /pricing -> Review plan details -> Decide not to upgrade -> Stay on the pricing page or navigate back to /

features.name: Navigation & Session UI
features.description: Persistent global navigation that exposes primary routes and session affordances; shows a sign-in CTA for unauthenticated visitors and a user avatar/links for authenticated users.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See a persistent navbar with links to /pricing and a sign-in CTA (for unauthenticated users)
Navigate to /dashboard -> See a persistent navbar with a user avatar and links to /pricing (for authenticated users)

features.name: Landing Page & Demo Verification
features.description: Public landing page with hero, value proposition, and the demo "Verify Job URL" widget that calls the backend /api/demo-verify endpoint to show live job-status checking.

pages.description: Landing page with hero, features, CTA to sign in, and the demo-verify widget

features.name: Google OAuth Sign-In
features.description: NextAuth-driven sign-in flow with the Google provider. Establishes a session cookie and calls the backend /api/sync-user endpoint after a successful sign-in to upsert the user record.

features.name: Onboarding & Resume Upload
features.description: First-time sign-in flow that collects the user's region, direction, degree, and visa needs, then uploads a resume PDF/DOCX to the backend /api/parse endpoint.

pages.description: Dashboard entry point; runs onboarding for new users, then shows search results

features.name: Dashboard — Job Search & Core Promise Results
features.description: Authenticated dashboard. Calls backend /api/search with the user's direction/region/degree/visa and renders the promise-gated job list (open, location match, direction match, identity match). Includes region and degree filters.

pages.description: Job search results with region, direction, degree, and visa filters

features.name: Cover Letter Generation
features.description: On a selected job card, triggers the backend /api/generate-cls/stream (SSE) endpoint and renders tokens as they stream. Also supports copying the final letter.

pages.description: Cover letter drawer/modal rendered in-place on the dashboard

depends_on: Dashboard — Job Search & Core Promise Results

features.name: Pricing & Stripe Checkout
features.description: Pricing page showing the paid tier. "Upgrade" button calls backend /api/stripe/create-checkout to create a Stripe Checkout Session and redirects to Stripe.

pages.description: Pricing page with free vs paid comparison and upgrade CTA

features.name: Navigation & Session UI
features.description: Global navbar with sign-in/sign-out button, user avatar when authenticated, and links to /dashboard and /pricing.

known_limitations.issue: Dev server (next dev) is single-threaded and may throttle under concurrent TestSprite load; tests capped at 15 high-priority cases
Frontend assumes the backend at NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is reachable; tests must have the local Flask backend on 5001 running
known_limitations.impact: Any flow that calls /api/search, /api/parse, /api/generate-cls/stream, or /api/sync-user will fail if the backend is down

known_limitations.issue: The /api/sync-user call in the NextAuth callback may still be tied to the google_id payload bug surfaced in backend Round 1
known_limitations.impact: Sign-in flow may appear to succeed client-side but silently fail to upsert the user in Postgres
